Name: Anthro Victoria (Classic Anthro Victor Genderswap)
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
This is a genderswap of Classic Anthro Victor so that she fits in with the characters from Anthro Characters Continued/FurrySVE!

While mods for anthropomorphizing Victor exists, and mods that genderswap him exists, this mod is the only one so far that does both.

Earlier this year, I created portraits and sprites for the anthro versions of the genderswaps of Alex, Sebastian, and Shane before their ACC artwork came out. Now that its come out, I edited together Sebastian/Sabrina's, Sam's, Classic Victor's, and Classic Olivia's sprites and portraits together so that both versions of Sabrina's artwork can be used together. Victoria is a fox probably, but you can interpret her as any sort of canine, as long as you can imagine it. Between this and the Anthro Lannah mod I made earlier, now every love interest in Furry SDVE can be a girl.

 I also edited the dialogue to reference Victoria as female. I probably didn't get everything though, so let me know what I missed. As a bonus Victoria uses her beach outfit in the bathhouse now if you can somehow get her there.

This is a standard Content Patcher mod. Install it like you would any other.

This is the third in a series of projects meant to utilize anthro artworks that would otherwise not be simultaneously used with each other, or otherwise unused. The first part of this project was Quinn, which you can see here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50464 . The second was Lnnah, which is here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51218

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
This mod requires Furry SVE, and, naturally, Stardew Valley Expanded. Of course, I also made this with my own Alternate Anthro Sabrina in mind.
